name: tab-autorename
description: Firefox MV3 add-on to rename tab titles using site rules and URL placeholders
author: calladot

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:js && npm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: shx mkdir -p dist/popup dist/icons && shx cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && shx cp -r src/popup/* dist/popup && shx cp -r src/icons/* dist/icons
scripts.webext:build: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist -a artifacts --overwrite-dest
